feedbackDiagnosis.evidence: The application already renders an accessible status while the history module loads. Version 1 only searched inside the history aside, which mounts later, so the existing module-loading feedback was not measured.
feedbackDiagnosis.acceptance: First-run feedback measurements remain failed evidence. Corrected measurements require a new complete run; no durations are retrospectively replaced.

readinessCounterexample.evidence: The new archived row names could render before the page-specific directory response. Version 1 checked names and links but did not require confirmed directory metadata, so its readiness endpoint could precede the actual response.
readinessCounterexample.acceptance: This early latency is not valid product performance evidence. The backend response, original facts and final rendered cards were separately verified; those functional checks do not validate this premature paint timestamp.
